title: November Examination
instructions: This paper consists of FOUR questions. Answer ALL the questions.
Round off answers to TWO decimal places, unless stated otherwise.
Units must be shown in final answers. Tax tables and exchange rates are illustrative.

context.text: Sipho runs a small business making school jerseys. Fixed costs are R4 200 per month. Each jersey costs R85 to make and sells for R160.

questions.prompt: Write formulas for Sipho's monthly cost ($C$) and income ($I$) for $n$ jerseys.
Calculate the break-even number of jerseys.
Calculate Sipho's profit if he sells 90 jerseys in a month.
Using the illustrative tax table (R240 001 – R375 000: R43 200 + 26% of the amount above R240 000; primary rebate R17 500), calculate the annual tax on a taxable income of R350 000.
A personal loan of R25 000 is repaid with 30 instalments of R1 120 plus an initiation fee of R1 150. Calculate the total cost of credit.
R8 000 is invested at 7,2% p.a. compounded monthly for 2 years. Calculate the final amount.
Inflation is 6% per year. If Sipho's fixed costs rise with inflation, what will they be in two years' time?

A medical aid covers a taxpayer, her spouse and two children. Using illustrative credits of R364 (main member), R364 (first dependant) and R246 (each additional dependant) per month, calculate the annual medical tax credit.

context.text: Illustrative rates: US\$1 = R18,60; €1 = R20,20; £1 = R23,80.

questions.prompt: Convert €450 to rand.
How many US dollars can be bought with R7 440?
Explain how a weakening rand affects (a) the price of imported cellphones and (b) South African fruit exporters.
questions.memo:
(a) ✓ Imports become more expensive (1)
(b) ✓ Exporters earn more rand for each dollar of sales (1) ✓ so their products are more competitive (1)

questions.prompt: A cylindrical tin has a radius of 5 cm and a height of 12 cm. Calculate its volume in millilitres and the area of its label (around the side only). Use $\pi = 3{,}142$.
Tins with a diameter of 10 cm and height 12 cm are packed upright in a box 50 cm × 40 cm × 24 cm. How many tins fit?
A tourist from the UK buys a carving for R1 666 in Cape Town. How much is this in pounds, and is it cheaper than a similar carving costing £75 in London?
On a 1 : 200 000 map, the distance between two towns is 14,5 cm. Calculate the real distance in km.
A family drives 720 km at an average speed of 90 km/h with two 20-minute stops. They leave at 05:45. At what time do they arrive?
questions.memo:
✓ 720 ÷ 90 = 8 h (1)
✓ Stops 40 min (1)
✓ Total 8 h 40 min (1)
✓ Arrive 14:25 (1)

questions.prompt: Their car uses 7,8 ℓ/100 km and petrol costs R23,40/ℓ. Calculate the fuel cost for the 720 km trip.
On a 1 : 50 plan, a room measures 10 cm by 8 cm and the room is 2,8 m high. Calculate the volume of the room.
A 1 : 25 scale model of a car is 18 cm long. How long is the real car in metres, and how long would a 1 : 18 model of the same car be (to the nearest cm)?

context.text: Monthly salaries at a small company (rand): 9 500; 9 500; 10 200; 11 000; 11 800; 12 500; 14 000; 48 000

questions.prompt: Calculate the mean salary.
Determine the median salary.
The company advertises 'average salary over R15 000'. Is this misleading? Explain.
questions.memo:
✓ Yes (1)
✓ The mean is inflated by one high salary (R48 000); most workers earn far less, and the median is R11 400 (1)

questions.prompt: A game costs R8. You roll a die and win R30 if you roll a 6. (a) Calculate the expected value per game. (b) Is the game fair?
questions.memo:
(a) ✓ $\frac{1}{6} \times R30 = R5$ (1) ✓ R5 − R8 = −R3 (1)
(b) ✓ Not fair (1) ✓ the player loses R3 per game on average (1)

questions.prompt: Of 500 people tested, 40 have a condition. Of these, 36 test positive. Of the 460 without it, 46 test positive. If a person tests positive, what is the probability they have the condition?
The probability that a flight is delayed is 0,15. For two independent flights, find P(neither is delayed).
Calculate the range and explain why the interquartile range would be a better measure of spread for the salary data.
questions.memo:
✓ Range = R48 000 − R9 500 = R38 500 (1)
✓ The range is affected by the outlier (R48 000) (1)
✓ The IQR uses the middle 50% and ignores extremes (1)
